en: Get on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Inhale: arch your back down, lift your head (Cow)
Exhale: round your back up, tuck your chin (Cat)
Move slowly with your breathing rhythm
id: Posisi merangkak, tangan di bawah bahu, lutut di bawah pinggul
Tarik napas: lengkungkan punggung ke bawah, angkat kepala (Cow)
Buang napas: bulatkan punggung ke atas, tundukkan kepala (Cat)
Lakukan perlahan dengan irama napas

benefit.en: Improves spinal flexibility and reduces stiffness
benefit.id: Meningkatkan fleksibilitas tulang belakang dan mengurangi kekakuan

en: Lie on your back on the floor
Bend one knee, gently pull it toward your chest
Hold 15-30 seconds, feel the stretch in your lower back
Switch legs, then try both knees together
id: Berbaring telentang di lantai
Tekuk satu lutut, tarik perlahan ke arah dada
Tahan 15-30 detik, rasakan peregangan di punggung bawah
Ganti kaki, lalu coba kedua lutut bersamaan

benefit.en: Releases pressure on the lower spinal nerves
benefit.id: Melepaskan tekanan pada saraf tulang belakang bagian bawah

en: Sit in a chair, feet flat on the floor
Place your right hand on your left knee
Slowly twist your body to the left, look behind
Hold, feel the stretch in your back
Return to center, repeat on the other side
id: Duduk di kursi, kaki rata di lantai
Letakkan tangan kanan di lutut kiri
Putar badan perlahan ke kiri, lihat ke belakang
Tahan, rasakan peregangan di punggung
Kembali ke tengah, ulangi sisi lainnya

benefit.en: Can be done at your desk, improves rotational mobility
benefit.id: Bisa dilakukan di kursi kerja, meningkatkan mobilitas rotasi

en: Stand straight, place both hands on your lower back
Slowly arch your back backward
Hold 2-3 seconds at the end position
Return to standing position
id: Berdiri tegak, letakkan kedua tangan di punggung bawah
Perlahan lengkungkan punggung ke belakang
Tahan 2-3 detik di posisi akhir
Kembali ke posisi tegak

benefit.en: Counterbalances hunched sitting posture, easy to do anywhere
benefit.id: Counterbalance posisi duduk membungkuk, mudah dilakukan di mana saja

en: Kneel down, sit on your heels
Stretch your arms forward, forehead to the floor
Breathe deeply, feel your back lengthening
Relax and hold the position
id: Berlutut, duduk di atas tumit
Rentangkan tangan ke depan, dahi ke lantai
Tarik napas dalam, rasakan punggung memanjang
Rileks dan tahan posisi

benefit.en: A very relaxing passive stretch for the entire back
benefit.id: Peregangan pasif yang sangat relaksasi untuk seluruh punggung

en: Sit in a chair, lift your right leg, place ankle on left knee (figure-4)
Keep your back straight, slowly lean forward
Feel the stretch in your right buttock and hip
Hold, then switch sides
id: Duduk di kursi, angkat kaki kanan, taruh ankle di lutut kiri (figure-4)
Tegakkan punggung, perlahan condongkan badan ke depan
Rasakan peregangan di bokong dan pinggul kanan
Tahan, lalu ganti sisi

benefit.en: Often related to sciatica, can be done at your desk
benefit.id: Sering terkait sciatica, bisa dilakukan di kursi kerja

en: Lie on your back, bend knees, feet flat on the floor
Tighten your abdominal muscles, flatten your back to the floor
Hold 5 seconds, then relax
Repeat with a steady rhythm
id: Berbaring telentang, tekuk lutut, kaki rata di lantai
Kencangkan otot perut, ratakan punggung ke lantai
Tahan 5 detik, lalu rileks
Ulangi dengan ritme yang stabil

benefit.en: Strengthens core stabilizers, fundamental for LBP rehabilitation
benefit.id: Memperkuat core stabilizer, dasar rehabilitasi LBP

en: Half-kneeling lunge position
Front leg bent 90°, back knee on the floor
Slowly push your hips forward
Feel the stretch in the front of your back thigh
Keep your back straight
id: Posisi berlutut satu kaki (half-kneeling lunge)
Kaki depan ditekuk 90°, lutut belakang di lantai
Dorong pinggul ke depan perlahan
Rasakan peregangan di depan paha kaki belakang
Jaga punggung tetap tegak

benefit.en: Prolonged sitting shortens hip flexors, causing anterior pelvic tilt and LBP
benefit.id: Duduk lama membuat hip flexor pendek, ini menyebabkan anterior pelvic tilt dan LBP
